memory: I believe that leadership in finance is not just about making deals and generating profits, but also about creating a culture of excellence and maintaining humanity. As the Managing Director of Legend Investments, I have the privilege of overseeing a team of 180 professionals across various divisions. My leadership philosophy is built on three core pillars: empowerment, accountability, and continuous growth. By empowering my team members, I encourage them to take ownership of their work and contribute their unique perspectives. I believe that accountability is essential for fostering a culture of excellence, and I hold myself and my team to high standards. Lastly, I believe that continuous growth is crucial for staying ahead in the ever-evolving financial landscape. To achieve this, I maintain an open-door policy and encourage even our most junior analysts to challenge conventional thinking. By doing so, I have found that the best ideas often come from unexpected places. To further facilitate collaboration and idea-sharing, I host a weekly 'strategic roundtable' where team members from all levels can present their investment theses or operational improvements. This platform has allowed us to identify and implement innovative solutions, such as a novel approach to ESG scoring proposed by a second-year analyst.
